releaseName: The work journal for coding agents
summary: Work journal sprint (milestone 64, ADR 0011 D17): the first agent channel. A new draftloop-mcp stdio MCP server lets the candidate's coding agent record notable work it helped ship with record_work, and list what it recorded with list_work, through the self-hosted server's API and its owner token. Notes are checked, deduplicated, screened for injected instructions and rate limited, and wait as pending until the candidate turns on intake and reviews them in a Work journal panel on the Career evidence page or with draft-loop work-journal in the CLI: approve, edit, merge a likely duplicate or discard. An approved note becomes a Markdown knowledge source of the new work-journal evidence kind, sensitive by default for a private project, with its repository and links never sent to a model provider. draftloop-mcp init sets up Claude Code, Codex or another MCP host in one project, with an instructions snippet, a /log-work skill and an opt-in advisory Stop hook.
knownLimitations: The work journal is served with the owner token only, so staging in sign-in mode does not offer it, and notes are not yet in the record archive (#2079). A full run citing an approved note and walks in Claude Code and Codex are still to do. Staging behaviour is otherwise unchanged.
